TL;DR Aristotle API now supports autoformalization, lemma generation, and more! Sign up for access at aristotle.harmonic.fun; we'll be clearing folks every day going forward!

We are excited to launch agent mode in the Aristotle API. Agent mode supports:

  1. Autoformalization - You can submit your LaTeX, markdown, or even general questions, and Aristotle will autoformalize it.
  2. Lemma Generation - Aristotle will generate lemmas and use them to produce easier to maintain code. This is supported for both natural language and lean inputs.
  3. A better UI - The Aristotle SDK now ships with a UI in the terminal for a more natural and accessible workflow.

Sign up at aristotle.harmonic.fun to try it today!
For discussion, please use #mathlib4 > Discussion thread for Aristotle API.
